description: The centre's Telnyx account, connected from Settings > Phone > Telephony > Telnyx (doc 64).

fields.description: Spoken to the other party before they are connected, so recording is disclosed on the leg being recorded. Leave empty for no announcement. The voice and language are the answering service's.
fields.label: Recording Notice

fields.description: Where calls may go: country codes separated by commas, IT for Italy. Premium-rate numbers are never called, whatever the country. Telnyx's outbound voice profile is told the same.
fields.label: Countries That Can Be Called

fields.description: What people see as the sender of every SMS the centre sends: its name, or one of its numbers when the answers must come back.
fields.label: SMS Sender

fields.description: Up to 11 letters without accents, digits and spaces: nobody can answer a name.
fields.label: Sender's Name

fields.description: One of the account's numbers that can send SMS: the answers come back to the person's conversation.
fields.label: Sender's Number

fields.description: When this month's spend reaches this amount, in the Telnyx account's currency, whoever pays for the account is told. Empty: no alert.
fields.label: Spend Alert

fields.description: When the Telnyx balance goes down to this amount, whoever pays for the account is told, before calls and SMS stop. Empty: no alert.
fields.label: Low Balance Alert

fields.description: The month whose spend alert was told: once a month.
fields.label: Spend Alert Told

fields.description: Whether the low balance was told: once until it is topped up.
fields.label: Low Balance Told

fields.description: Whose account it is: the centre's own, or the agency's for a centre with the agency's front desk.
fields.label: Whose Account

fields.description: The account's API key, kept encrypted: Telnyx has no key limited to a part of an account.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: The account's public key, which Telnyx signs every webhook with (Mission Control > Keys & Credentials > Public Key).
fields.label: Webhook Public Key

fields.description: A managed account made in the agency's account for this site, with its own key.
fields.label: Managed Account

fields.description: Where Telnyx asks what a call to one of the centre's numbers does.
fields.label: TeXML Application

fields.description: Where the browser's calls register: each person has a credential of their own on it.
fields.label: Credential Connection

fields.description: The countries calls may go to, and nothing else.
fields.label: Outbound Voice Profile

fields.description: Where the numbers' SMS come and go.
fields.label: Messaging Profile

fields.description: Reject webhooks that are not signed by Telnyx. Only turn this off to debug a proxy that rewrites the requests.
fields.label: Verify Webhook Signature

fields.description: Public address Telnyx calls back on, e.g. https://crm.studio.it or a tunnel in development. Leave empty to use the site URL.
fields.label: Callback Base URL

name: CRM Telnyx Settings
